items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: I said, well when I played with him, poor Garnier couldn't play, and he was trying to play that trumpet

ctx.x: Did you play with many jump up bands like that? Why sure.

I didn't let nobody down. Because this is the situation. We have to encourage one another. Not to find a fault and all that kind of stuff. That's no good. That's why I was crazy about me all those musicians. I said, well all right, you're all going with me. I said, let's go. Hop, bing, bing, bing. You see? We picked it up. But no, no, I told Garnier, I said, don't ever get a drummer like that to play no music. I said, because now you know yourself, we can't play like that. I said, because you're going one, two,…
Well you mean that many of these men that had these bands in these schools thought they could get out and make a little extra money out of them. But you see, Garnier, he didn't give up.
